title: Live-oak foliage spray atlas (derived)
license: CC0 1.0 — derived from ambientCG LeafSet022 (CC0); derivative released CC0
preparation: tools/vegetation/build_foliage_atlas.py: the 6 photographed leaves are cut by their opacity masks, recoloured toward dark olive live-oak green (luminance detail kept), scaled to ~4-8 cm on a 1 m card, stamped along procedurally drawn twigs (3 open sprays + 1 dense clump), colour-bled into transparent texels; normal map stamped with rotated tangent-space normals. Reference-guided authoring: not a scan of Quercus virginiana. Follow-up 2 (2026-10-19): brighter, more varied leaf palette (9 greens incl. sunlit and grey-green underside tones).

treeSites.source: UT Austin TreeKeeper public map (Davey Resource Group TreeKeeper), GeoServer service https://geocomyt.daveytreekeeper.com/geoserver/Treekeeper/wms (public map config: research/raw/ut-tree-public-map-service.json), layer UofTAustin_CampusTrees; public site viewer https://utaustin.treekeepersoftware.com/
treeSites.captured: 2026-09-06 (GeoJSON point export, EPSG:4326, 4,860 features; WFS timeStamp of the same service sample 2026-09-06T10:57Z). The exact export query URL was not recorded with the capture.
treeSites.license: No explicit open license is stated by the public UT map service. Only point positions, site_id and the numeric tree_type are used; no species, photos, attributes or imagery are shipped. Integrator/UT to confirm terms before public release.
treeSites.preparation: tools/vegetation/build_tree_sites.py: projected with the campus formula (origin -97.73716, 30.2861; SX = 111320*cos(30.2861 deg), SZ = 110851), clipped to campus bounds [-760,-864,1296,1536], rounded to 0.01 m. 4,812 sites in bounds (type 1: 4,753; type 2: 43; type 3: 16).
treeSites.interpretation: Inventory SITE positions, not verified living trunks. tree_type enum is unpublished; TreeKeeper sites can be existing trees, stumps or vacant planting sites (https://daveyresourcegroup.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/TKS/pages/691568708/Life%2BCycle%2Bof%2Ba%2BTree%2BSite). The game instantiates type 1 only; types 2/3 only extend inventory coverage.
